<p align="center"><strong>Find the way out. Or a reason to stay.</strong></p>


<p align="center">You followed a light through the trees. Now a ghost is holding the door open, and the garden gate has clicked shut behind you.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;Two little locks,&quot; it says. &quot;One key, one song. You can leave whenever you solve them. Tea is entirely optional.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">Two chapters, seven puzzles and six endings. Escape the house for a shorter adventure, or follow the unlit lanterns beyond the garden to discover the nightkeeper's story.</p>

<p align="center">Choose the wooden buttons to explore. There is no timer, wrong answers are recoverable, and you can bookmark any page to resume later.</p>
